#236 · Scuffle Pokémon

Tyrogue

Fighting

Johto · Generation 2 · Baby Pokémon

Tyrogue is a Fighting-type Scuffle Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 21 kg. It evolves into Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan and Hitmontop. Its highest base stat is HP (35), with a base stat total of 210.
